name: Oscar Henkle
source:
Cloaked in mystery and irresistible charm, the Patron provides the means for the Faeologist's studies and research. 
His words sweet, but a sense of something concealed lingers in his every action. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3369020/Death__Faeology/]Steam[/url]]
